newsitem.title: UK: UK's IMRO fines Newton Investment Management.
newsitem.headline: UK's IMRO fines Newton Investment Management.

text.p: The UK's Investment Management Regulatory Organisation (IMRO) has fined Newton Investment Management 85,000 stg for breaches of rules relating to overdrafts on client money accounts.

A statement said IMRO brought the proceedings for failing to prevent the overdraughts occurring, failing to inform IMRO promptly and fully when they became aware of the overdrafts, and failing to identify the occurrence and take adequate action to prevent a re-occurrence.
Newton agreed to a settlement of the disciplinary proceedings prior to a full hearing of the case by the Disciplinary Tribunal.
IMRO said it had not alleged that Newton acted in bad faith in failing to inform it of the overdrafts.
Newton is to pay IMRO's investigation costs of 34,000 stg and to make a contribution towards the further costs incurred by IMRO in preparing for the tribunal hearing.
The Newton Group as a whole has some 10 billion stg under management. It has been authorised by IMRO since July 1988.
